title: Zoho Analytics Announces a Major Evolution #Shorts
description:
Zoho Analytics has announced a major evolution. Discover how this update helps businesses streamline reporting and build unified dashboards.

1. Open Zoho Analytics and integrate your live Zoho CRM and Zoho Books workspaces.
2. Click Ask Zia and type conversational prompts like 'Compare quarterly revenue growth versus pipeline velocity'.
3. Pin the automatically generated visual reports directly to your executive dashboard.

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation
